grammar.title: Concession: Albeit, Much As, Notwithstanding
grammar.explanation:
**Concession** means accepting one fact while saying something that contrasts with it. You already know **although**, **despite** and **in spite of**.

At this level, use more precise formal forms. Say *The plan worked, **albeit** slowly*, or ***Much as** I like him, I don't trust him*.

Use **albeit** before an adjective, adverb or phrase, never a full clause. A chatty guide can be excellent, **albeit** expensive.

Use **much as** before a clause to mean although very much. **Much as** I wanted to stay blissfully happy, I had to hear the news.

Use **notwithstanding** before or after a noun in formal writing. **Notwithstanding** the cost, the plan was approved.

Use **however** plus an adjective or adverb to mean it doesn't matter how. **However hard** I try, I can't understand it.

Use an adjective plus **as** or **though** for emphasis. **Strange as** it may seem, and **tired though** she was, are formal patterns.

Use **nevertheless** or **nonetheless** to start a new sentence that contrasts. It was risky. **Nevertheless**, we tried, and nobody needed to clench your fist in anger.
examples: *The results were positive, **albeit** with a few exceptions.* (albeit + phrase)
***Much as** I admire her work, I can't agree with her.* (much as + clause)
***Notwithstanding** the bad weather, the concert went ahead.* (notwithstanding + noun)
***However much** you earn, you'll always want more.* (however much)
***Tired though** she was, she kept working.* (adjective + though)

practice.q: Rewrite using albeit: She was blissfully happy, but only for a short time. (hint: a short happiness)
practice.a: She was blissfully happy, albeit briefly.

practice.q: Rewrite using much as: Although I love talking to my chatty friend very much, I need some quiet today.
practice.a: Much as I love talking to my chatty friend, I need some quiet today.

practice.q: Rewrite using notwithstanding: Despite his chauvinistic remarks, the talk continued.
practice.a: Notwithstanding his chauvinistic remarks, the talk continued.

practice.q: Rewrite using however + adjective: It doesn't matter how hard he tries to bulk up, he needs rest too.
practice.a: However hard he tries to bulk up, he needs rest too.
